[P2] The related-work map omits substantial cross-subject silent-speech EEG/EMG work — `cross_subject_speech_decoder_map.md:30-35, 63-87`; `cross_subject_speech_decoder_sources.md:3-27`
The map includes CAT-Net but not Inoue et al.’s Interspeech 2025 heterogeneous-configuration EEG/EMG silent-speech decoder or their 2026 around-ear EEG study. These are relevant complementary evidence on cross-subject transfer and practical silent-speech decoding; the latter reports 282.4 total training hours and evaluates a 64-word task including an incomplete-LIS participant. Although their multimodal signals and bounded-vocabulary task differ from imagined-speech EEG, their absence leaves a material gap in the landscape and omits an important adjacent positive-results line. citeturn894074search2turn894074search0
